version.author: kallums
version.changelog: Names the chord you are playing by reading it rather than looking it up, so extended and thin voicings are named instead of being read out as notes. Note names are spelled for the key, with a Simplify Note Names option for piano-key naming. The scale is remembered per project and a toolbar button lights up while the script runs.

version.author: kallums
version.changelog: ScaleView Pro without the chord detection: it does not listen to what you play and names no chords. The icon, scales, key-aware spelling, menus, colours and per-project scale all behave exactly as they do in Pro.
